description:
Goal
Introduce the static product-key pull driver for the new artifact path. A ProductKey names the product being demanded; the driver maps each key kind to exactly one producer and memoizes product results for the current request.

Required shape
- Define the product-key vocabulary needed by ../pull-based.html: RootBackendProduct, BackendExecutable, AbiExecutable, MaterializedExecutable, ExecutableEffects, RuntimeDemand, OutgoingInputEdges, IncomingInputSlot, TransportShape, TransportComponent, CallableFacts, and BoundaryFacts.
- Add telemetry for product requested, produced, waited, cache hit, and reentered.
- Producers return product/fact waits when prerequisites are missing. They do not enqueue follow_up jobs and do not self-schedule.
- Keep this as scaffolding behind the new path; do not route production backend work through it until later tickets supply the products.

Signal
A unit test pulls a fake product with a fake prerequisite through the driver. Duplicate requests coalesce or hit the cache. The wait path names a product key or fact wait and contains no JobEffects::follow_up.

Removal target
None yet. This ticket creates the minimal pull substrate needed for the later removal tickets.

Verification
cargo fmt --all; targeted product-driver tests; cargo test -p fz --lib compiler2 if the local suite naming supports it.
title: Pull path: add ProductKey driver and product telemetry
